title: Pricing Assist Methodology Statement — The All-In Night and the Suggested Nightly Rate (Listings)
content:
# Pricing Assist Methodology Statement

*Pricing team, Roamhaven Listings. Pricing Assist is the nightly rate Roamhaven suggests for a listing.*

## Definitions

**(a) All-in night.** Pricing Assist prices the all-in night of a full party: the listing's nightly rate, plus its regular cleaning fee spread over the stay length Pricing Assist expects, plus its extra-guest fee multiplied by the number of guests by which the listing's maximum guests exceeds its extra-guest threshold (none when it does not exceed it).

**(b) Cleaning fee spread.** The regular cleaning fee divided by the expected stay length in nights. The standard expected stay length is the listing's minimum stay in nights.

**(c) Adjustment total.** Pricing Assist adjustments are fractions of the all-in night, each worked out on the day of the request; they are first added together into one adjustment total.

**(d) Suggested nightly rate.** The suggested nightly rate is the current nightly rate plus the all-in night multiplied by the adjustment total, kept within the space type's nightly-rate minimum and nightly-rate maximum, and rounded half up to the cent at that final step only.

**(e) Standard suggestion.** The standard suggested nightly rate is the listing's current nightly rate, unchanged, kept within the space type's nightly-rate minimum and nightly-rate maximum.

## Inputs read from the listing record

Nightly rate, regular cleaning fee, minimum stay, maximum guests, extra-guest threshold, extra-guest fee and space type.

## Worked example (hypothetical listing)

Nightly rate $150.00; regular cleaning fee $90.00; minimum stay 3 nights; maximum guests 6; extra-guest threshold 4; extra-guest fee $15.00; space type's nightly-rate range $10.00 to $25000.00.

1. Cleaning fee spread: $90.00 divided by 3 nights is $30.00.
2. Extra guests in a full party: 6 less 4 is 2; multiplied by $15.00 that is $30.00.
3. All-in night: $150.00 plus $30.00 plus $30.00 is $210.00.
4. Standard suggestion: $150.00, within the range.
5. Were the adjustment total 0.03 (a hypothetical figure), the suggested nightly rate would be $150.00 plus $210.00 multiplied by 0.03, that is $150.00 plus $6.30, giving $156.30.

A listing whose maximum guests is 4 and whose extra-guest threshold is 4 has no extra guests in a full party: that part of the all-in night is none.

## Range check (hypothetical)

A listing of a space type whose nightly-rate minimum were $300.00, carrying a current nightly rate of $290.00, has a standard suggestion of $300.00, the rate being kept within the range.
